tasks.source_text: Animals play a role in people's lives. Your friend does not know how to take care of his new pet.  Tell your friend at ;least three ways how to take care of his new pet.

tasks.source_text: People use water every day for different reasons. Your little sister does not know how to wash a car. Tell your sister at least three steps to wash the car.
